title: Uncurried transport through ordinary, closed and exceptional adjunctions
statement:
Fix the scheme and four coefficient-stage conventions of [def-fix-six-functor-datum]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a separated finite-type morphism of finite-type $k$-schemes, with the exceptional adjunction supplied as in [fix-prop-adjunctions]. Let $M\in D^b_{ctf}(X,\Lambda)$ and $N\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,\Lambda)$. Use the derived operations [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], the chosen restricted tensor–Hom adjunction [det-thm-sf-ctf-stability-adjunctions], and the projection isomorphism [fix-prop-projection-formula] with its map specified in [def-exchange-projection]. Put
$$C=Rf_!M,\qquad L_N=R\mathcal Hom_X(M,Rf^!N),\qquad A_N=Rf_*L_N,\qquad B_N=R\mathcal Hom_Y(C,N).$$
Integral pullback and tensor are completed; field operations use rationalization and common finite coefficient stages. Write $\varepsilon_{L_N}:Lf^*A_N\to L_N$ and $\mu_N:Rf_!Rf^!N\to N$ for the ordinary and exceptional counits, and $P_T:C\otimes^LT\to Rf_!(M\otimes^LLf^*T)$ for projection. Define
$$q_N=\operatorname{ev}_{M,Rf^!N}\circ(1_M\otimes\varepsilon_{L_N}):M\otimes^LLf^*A_N\to Rf^!N,$$
$$p_N=\mu_N\circ Rf_!(q_N)\circ P_{A_N}:C\otimes^LA_N\to N,$$
where evaluation is the counit of the chosen left-factor tensor–Hom adjunction [lem-pod-closed-uncurry-laws]. For $T\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,\Lambda)$ and $t:T\to A_N$, the successive images of $t$ under inverse ordinary adjunction, inverse tensor–Hom adjunction with left factor $M$, inverse exceptional adjunction, and precomposition with $P_T$ are respectively
$$u_t=\varepsilon_{L_N}\circ Lf^*t:Lf^*T\to L_N,$$
$$v_t=\operatorname{ev}_{M,Rf^!N}\circ(1_M\otimes u_t)=q_N\circ(1_M\otimes Lf^*t):M\otimes^LLf^*T\to Rf^!N,$$
$$z_t=\mu_N\circ Rf_!(v_t):Rf_!(M\otimes^LLf^*T)\to N,$$
$$w_t=z_t\circ P_T=p_N\circ(1_C\otimes t):C\otimes^LT\to N.$$
Here the projection square at $t$ has the specified equality
$$Rf_!(1_M\otimes Lf^*t)\circ P_T=P_{A_N}\circ(1_C\otimes t).$$

proof.text: First prove raw projection naturality at any map t:T→U by applying the naturality field of [fix-prop-projection-formula] with identity first-factor map. Handle finite, integral, rational, and common stages using their respective law records; use the stipulated finite-Tor properties at finite and integral stages. Apply the faithful full inclusion on Y to the desired transported projection square. Expand preimageIso and map_preimage. Naturality of the chosen tensor comparison on Y, the raw projection square, and the inverse tensor comparison on X give the square; faithfulness reflects it. Specialize U=A_N to prove the last displayed equality.

source.place: Step 1, projection-formula bijection and its naturality in the test object

proof.text:
Insert the formula for $v_t$ from step 2 into $w_t=z_t\circ P_T$. Functoriality of $Rf_!$, the square in step 4, and associativity of composition give
$$\begin{aligned}w_t&=\mu_N\circ Rf_!(q_N)\circ Rf_!(1_M\otimes Lf^*t)\circ P_T\\&=\mu_N\circ Rf_!(q_N)\circ P_{A_N}\circ(1_C\otimes t)\\&=p_N\circ(1_C\otimes t).\end{aligned}$$
The last equality is the definition of $p_N$. This proves all four successive-image formulas and the specified projection equality. The argument takes place in the already chosen coefficient-stage categories: the integral functors are the completed ones, and the field functors and maps are their stipulated rationalizations and common-stage morphisms; no additional coefficient comparison is asserted.
